summary: Owner request (2026-11-05, #1010): source and defend the two open bridges of WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE. Pinned and read: Dei Filius ch. 4 and canons IV (Latin, vatican.va), CIC 1983 cann. 747-755 and 1364-1369 (Latin, vatican.va; Book VI as revised 2021), Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.2-I.3 n.2 (Corpus Thomisticum), PU §373 (pinned German), SEP Fideism §3. (a) is supported by the practice's law of teaching (can. 749 §2), membership (cann. 750-751, 1364-1365), its self-description (Dei Filius ch. 4, can. IV.3 on the declared sense of dogma) and Wittgenstein's 'Theologie als Grammatik'; (b) by Dei Filius ch. 4 (two orders distinct in principle; God known by the gentiles) and SCG I.2-3 (natural reason to which all must assent, against pagans; the philosophers' proofs). The fideist replies are recorded at full strength as unattributed alternatives (conciliar teaching is theology, not grammar; natural reason within a theological horizon), with the supports they have (Phillips 2005, 75; Clayton and Taylor) and the texts against them as attacks. Rejected: recording either bridge as stated (no text states it; each source leaves a named gap) or the attacks as refutations (their premises are stated, not established). Logic-first follow-up for the Moorean candidate batch (#1119, 2026-11-06): the grammar-case vocabulary now exists (FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-PARTITION), so its absence is no longer the blocker. The exact original Challenge still has three unestablished inputs, including the stated CouncilDefinesNaturalKnowabilityReading, not only these two bridges. FideismFailsAsDescription is the negation of InternalGrammarReading ∧ CutOffReading; the recorded alternative to revelation is CutOffReading alone. No refutes relation targets that single rival. In-memory frontier settlement probes at main 0367eebc establish the bundle-failure result if all three inputs are hypothetically settled, but do not refute CutOffReading or lower any route. See docs/notes/moorean-floor-candidates.md for the ranked candidate batch, precise scopes and remaining registration/interpretation gaps. Conciliar theology/grammar definition audit (2026-11-06): the old untyped theology-not-grammar alternative to the normative definition bridge is now scoped to the exact bridge negation. Raw reply/source claims remain unchanged. New typed siblings distinguish theological content, practical religious-life role, actual own-standard endorsement and a substantive theology-excluded-from-own-standards premise. Descriptive content alone permits the old normative bridge; it neither identifies nor refutes the strong exclusion reading. Content+explicit exclusion+an actual Defined witness composes into the exact bridge negation. Shared own-status, never-own status and actual mixed defined witnesses form a checked EM fork; named uniform coverage stays open. Four controls preserve a positive religious-life endorsed move, witness descriptive theology with the bridge true, explicit exclusion with actual bridge failure and the old fideist pair, mixed status, and empty-definition universal overlap. The older needsDefinitionIsOwnStandard theorem shows a missing bridge, not identity of a descriptive theology thesis with its negation. The new two-move exclusion control keeps ordinary endorsement nonempty rather than repeating its all-OwnStandard-false fixture. The old bridge paraphrase now states only normative endorsement and leaves theological/practical roles separate; its Lean type and source claims are unchanged. Council-defined natural knowability supplies a weak actual Defined witness; original cut-off arguments still need both Defined and natural content, and retain explicit strong-version reasons. No author attribution, actual institutional/liturgical fact, philosophical floor or root premise is established.
blocker: The two interpretation bridges and the council premise remain unestablished. Grammar-case vocabulary is available, but the original theorem refutes a conjunction, whereas the recorded revelation rival is its CutOffReading conjunct alone. A counted single-rival refutation needs a checked specialization with an established InternalGrammar/profile premise, or a justified revision to the recorded rival bundle, and all its premises established. The relation's external-signs/shared-reason reading also remains untyped. Two bridge approvals alone do not close revelation; more sourcing is not on the critical path. The descriptive theology profile does not decide normative endorsement; its exclusion requires independent applicability/warrant. The raw mixed reply includes philosophical-distortion and grammar claims beyond this modest role profile; a stronger identity would need a typed content/fidelity criterion and explicit role/grammar mapping, not a descriptive label. Actual authority and source fidelity remain open; conditional role comparison does not require deciding them first.
